mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong economic expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST rise relative to the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises relative to the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals monetary tightening during an economic slowdown, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise relative to the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
